# Launch argv for #152's adjudicator on target-B, retained verbatim (a #199 gap the closeout named).
cd "<work>" || exit 2
date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ > dispatched_at.txt
timeout 3600 claude -p --session-id "2df6af6f-31b0-45d0-b7dc-7d4853207277" \
  --model claude-sonnet-5 --effort high --restricted \
  --tools "Bash,Read,Write,Edit,Glob,Grep" \
  --allowedTools <the read-only shell allow list plus Write and Edit; verbatim in sealed/> \
  --add-dir "<clone>" --add-dir "<inputs>" \
